description: Health and load of the whole FlakeGraph fleet at a glance.

panels.description: vLLM pods passing readiness against the number the StatefulSet wants. Fewer ready than desired is a rollout or a lost engine; the engine-down alert fires after five minutes.
panels.title: Engines ready

panels.description: Requests being decoded across the selected engines.
panels.title: Requests running

panels.description: Requests the engines have accepted but not started. Anything sustained above zero means callers are queueing.
panels.title: Requests waiting

panels.description: Output tokens per second across the selected engines.
panels.title: Generation tokens/s

panels.description: Prompt tokens per second, including tokens served from the prefix cache.
panels.title: Prompt tokens/s

panels.description: Running requests evicted from the KV cache in the last day. The serving design exists to keep this at zero; any value means an engine was oversubscribed.
panels.title: Preemptions, 24h

panels.description: Documents waiting for a parsing replica. Every shim replica reports the same shared queue, hence max rather than sum.
panels.title: OCR queued

panels.description: Parses dispatched to MinerU replicas right now.
panels.title: OCR in flight

panels.description: Pipeline tasks waiting for a worker, all stages, in queued or running runs. A failed or cancelled run keeps its unstarted tasks for a retry; those are reported as parked, not counted here.
panels.title: Tasks queued

panels.description: Pipeline tasks under lease by a worker.
panels.title: Tasks running

panels.description: Available replicas per worker pool. KEDA scales each pool to zero when its stages have no work.
panels.title: Worker pods

panels.description: Graph builds that have not finished.
panels.title: Runs active

panels.description: Share of each engine's KV cache in use. Above 0.9 the next burst preempts a running request.
panels.title: KV-cache usage

panels.description: Stacked: the waiting share should be a sliver.
panels.title: Running and waiting per engine

panels.description: Decode throughput per engine. Engines should track each other; one far below the rest is misrouted or unhealthy.
panels.title: Generation tokens/s per engine

panels.description: How long a caller waits for the first token. Interactive callers give up around ten seconds.
panels.title: Time to first token p95 per engine

panels.description: Time a request sat in the engine's queue before its first scheduler step. Rises before TTFT does.
panels.title: Queue time p95 per engine

panels.description: SM utilisation per GPU, as the DCGM exporter reports it. Empty until a DCGM exporter is scraped; see the DCGM namespace variable.
panels.title: GPU utilisation

panels.description: Board power draw.
panels.title: GPU power

panels.description: Die temperature. Thermal throttling shows up as clocks dropping while this stays flat at the limit.
panels.title: GPU temperature

panels.description: Share of all cores busy. Parsing and worker pods are the CPU consumers; the engines barely register.
panels.title: CPU utilisation

panels.description: Share of the node's memory in use. On a unified-memory part (a DGX Spark, for one) this is also the GPU memory: model weights and the KV cache live here, so a full node starves the engine as well as the pods.
panels.title: Memory used

panels.description: The root filesystem holds container images, the local-path PVCs and the model cache. Full means pods stop scheduling.
panels.title: Root disk used

panels.description: Physical interfaces only; pod and CNI interfaces are excluded so traffic is not counted twice.
panels.title: Network

panels.description: Requests reaching the engines' sidecars, by the class the presented key resolved to. `unauthenticated` requests were rejected.
panels.title: Sidecar requests/s by consumer class

panels.description: Generation throughput stacked to a fleet total.
panels.title: Tokens/s by engine

panels.description: Documents finished per minute, by how they ended. `upstream_timeout` and `upstream_error` are the parser failing; `rejected` is a bad key or a full queue.
panels.title: OCR parses/min by outcome

panels.description: Derived from the succeeded-task gauge, so a run being deleted reads as a dip (clamped at zero) rather than as work. The Pipeline dashboard has the exact history from Postgres.
panels.title: Tasks completed/min by stage

panels.description: Requests through the gateway, by the alias of the virtual key that made them.
panels.title: LiteLLM requests/s by key alias

panels.description: Every Prometheus alert firing in the cluster, from the chart's rules and the stack's bundled ones. Watchdog always fires to prove the pipeline works and is hidden.
panels.title: Firing alerts

title: Fleet Overview
